description: This file defines the Tcpdf class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for writing PDF files using the TCPDF external library. It extends the Pdf class and manages PDF creation, configuration, and saving functionality tailored to the Tcpdf implementation.

classes.name: Tcpdf
classes.description: A class extending the Pdf class to implement PDF writing using the TCPDF library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Tcpdf object with a Spreadsheet instance and enables inline CSS usage.

methods.name: createExternalWriterInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the external TCPDF library configured with page orientation, unit, and paper size.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Generates the PDF document from the spreadsheet data and writes it to a file specified by filename.
